why: This is a study-specific assessment battery comprising self-report scales and verified GPA rather than a reusable instructional element.
name: Questionnaire battery: LNT scale, technology scale, and GHQ-12 with verified GPA
product_description: A three-part online questionnaire battery combining measures of lighting, noise and temperature, technology adequacy for online learning, psychological distress, sociodemographics, and verified academic performance, used by the study researchers with undergraduate medical students.
